headline: Francis Marion beat Lees-McRae to keep their run going
dek: Francis Marion have won every match since their October defeat at Barton, and on Sunday that run took in Lees-McRae. It was only the second loss of the season for Lees-McRae, who have won fifteen and let in ten goals.
displaced_by: Francis Marion beat Lees-McRae on 2026-11-08, so the standing dek's 'lost once' and 'nine goals' no longer hold, and Lees-McRae did not host the match.

pattern.text: Chowan's 50 goals have come from at least fifteen different scorers and have still brought five defeats; spreading the scoring has not bought a clean record.
